game.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes
game.blurb: Family action-adventure in which Marvel heroes and villains are built from LEGO, from Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), released 2013-10-22. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Family. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 249130)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/LEGO_Marvel_Super_Heroes
Fandom (lego.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://lego.fandom.com/wiki/LEGO_Marvel_Super_Heroes
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); of its subpages only "Table of Contents" (about 2,600 characters) exists, so nothing was used. lego.fandom.com answers the API, with about 299 linked pages, many of them LEGO set and minifigure pages (for example "76005 Spider-Man: Daily Bugle Showdown", "Agent Coulson", "Abomination"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives no game name; the store list confirms app 249130 as "LEGO® Marvel™ Super Heroes". None of the 45 Steam achievements is hidden. The 15 story levels are split five to a chapter in their numbered order; "Post-Credit Party" (Complete House Party Protocol) sits with the last story chapter.
